description: Serial Port socket backend (ADR-0015): serial:true with QMP_MCP_SERIAL_BACKEND=socket emits a server-mode UNIX socket chardev (server=on,wait=off so it never blocks boot) at a serial.sock sibling of the managed QMP socket, bound to the machine's first serial port with -serial chardev. The Orchestrator dials it and pumps bytes both ways, so interactive write_serial reaches the guest. The path is server-derived (never agent/operator input). Board-agnostic. TCG.
